Relatives of gravely ill detainees at two Florida immigration jails say authorities are about to deport their loved ones to unknown countries in Africa despite worsening medical conditions.

The researchers have been at the heart of an ongoing dispute over research on African newborns, supported by $1.6m from the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and matched by the Pershing Square Foundation and the Bluebell Foundation for a total of $3.2m.

articles.title: US grants deportation reprieve to migrants from Ukraine and Sudan
articles.description:
DHS says migrants ‘retain protections’ after temporary protected status was set to expire on Monday

Send us your questions about immigration and the midterms

More than 100,000 people from Ukraine and Sudan can stay in the United States without immediate risk of deportation, the Department of Homeland Security said, in what amounts to a temporary reprieve after their right to stay in the country was set to expire on Monday.
Temporary protected status was set to end on Monday for about 101,000 Ukrainians and 1,800 Sudanese. But the DHS said an announcement “will be made at the appropriate time”. Until then, the department said in a written statement, Ukrainians and Sudanese in the US covered by those temporary measures “retain protection”. The department did not indicate how long they could stay or when a final announcement would be made on their status.
 Continue reading...

Mackenzie was arrested in 2023 after police received a tipoff, and weeks later authorities began uncovering bodies in shallow graves in the Shakahola forest near the coast ⁠in south-eastern Kenya.

articles.title: Hurricane Trudy menaces Mexico’s Pacific coast and Greece hit by deadly floods
articles.description:
Trudy weakens to tropical storm after warnings of strong winds and heavy rain, while one person killed in Greece
In contrast to the quiet Atlantic hurricane season, there has been ongoing activity in the Pacific, with Trudy being the 22nd and latest named system. The category 2 hurricane remained roughly 100 miles (160km) south-west of the coast of Mexico, meaning the worst of the conditions stayed offshore. However, the US National Hurricane Center put coastal parts of the states of Jalisco, Michoacán and Colima under hurricane warnings, with sustained winds of up to 60-90mph forecast on Sunday.
Rainfall totals of 100-150mm were likely for these areas, prompting warnings of flooding and landslides. Warnings also covered the risk of a dangerous storm surge accompanied by damaging waves in areas of onshore winds across the coast of south-western Mexico. By Monday morning, Trudy had weakened and been downgraded to a tropical storm, with coastal warnings being lifted.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: Three men jailed for 158 years each for murdering Australian and US surfers in Mexico
articles.description: Brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were killed on a surfing trip in an apparent botched robbery.
articles.titleJa: メキシコで豪米サーファー殺害、3人の男にそれぞれ禁錮158年
articles.summary: メキシコでオーストラリア人兄弟と米国人友人のサーファー3人が殺害された事件で、男3人にそれぞれ158年の禁錮刑が言い渡された。

articles.title: Maduro pleads not guilty to new torture-related charges in New York
articles.description: "I reject this document entirely," Maduro said in court, responding to newly added torture-related charges.
articles.titleJa: マドゥロ氏、ニューヨークでの新たな拷問関連容疑に無罪を主張
articles.summary: マドゥロ大統領がニューヨークの法廷で、追加された拷問関連の容疑に対し「この文書を完全に拒否する」と述べ、無罪を主張した。

articles.title: Brazil's Congress approves shorter working week in win for Lula
articles.description: Lula's supporters hope the measure will boost his popularity ahead of a presidential run-off in 10 days.
articles.titleJa: ブラジル議会が週労働時間短縮を承認、ルラ大統領の勝利
articles.summary: ブラジル議会が週労働時間短縮を承認。決選投票を10日後に控え、ルラ大統領支持者はこの措置が彼の人気を高めると期待している。

articles.title: Mexican man with suitcase full of snakes stopped at German airport
articles.description: The man, a Mexican firefighter, looked "nervous" as he tried to leave Cologne Airport, officials say.
articles.titleJa: スーツケースにヘビを満載したメキシコ人男性がドイツの空港で阻止される
articles.summary: メキシコ人男性がスーツケースにヘビを詰め込み、ケルン空港から出国しようとして身柄を確保された。当局によると、男性は「神経質」な様子だったという。

articles.title: Haitian migrants changed this US town - Trump's deportation drive is reshaping it again
articles.description: The president thrust Springfield, Ohio, into the spotlight with a false pet-eating claim - years later, it remains at the heart of the immigration debate.
articles.titleJa: ハイチ移民が変えた米国の町、トランプ氏の国外追放政策で再び再編
articles.summary: ハイチ移民が変革した米国オハイオ州スプリングフィールドは、トランプ前大統領の虚偽発言で注目され、現在も移民論争の中心にある。

articles.title: Five ways El Niño is affecting the weather around the world
articles.description: As the strongest El Niño on record continues to intensify, what impacts on weather patterns are already being felt across the globe? Sarah Keith-Lucas looks at the evidence.
articles.titleJa: エルニーニョ現象が世界の天候に与える5つの影響
articles.summary: 史上最強のエルニーニョ現象が進行中。世界各地で天候パターンにどのような影響が出ているのか、サラ・キース＝ルーカスが証拠を検証する。

articles.title: Pope's cancer diagnosis leaves Catholics questioning what comes next
articles.description: With few details so far, it is unclear what might need to change for a Pope who has been focused on stability.
articles.titleJa: 教皇の癌診断、カトリック教徒は次に来るものに疑問
articles.summary: 教皇の癌診断により、カトリック教徒の間では今後何が変わるのかという疑問が広がっている。詳細が少なく、安定を重視してきた教皇の役割変更は不透明。

articles.title: Huge crowds watch attempt to rescue shark stranded in South Korean canal
articles.description: A third attempt has been made to guide the 9ft 10in (3m) shark back to the open sea.
articles.titleJa: 韓国の運河で座礁したサメの救出試みを大勢の群衆が見守る
articles.summary: 韓国の運河に迷い込んだ約3mのサメを海に戻すための3度目の救出作業が行われ、大勢の住民がその様子を見守った。

articles.title: Billionaire Mukesh Ambani's Jio launches India's biggest share sale
articles.description: India's second mega IPO in a month comes despite subdued equity markets and aims to raise $3.2bn.
articles.titleJa: 億万長者ムケシュ・アンバニ氏のJio、インド最大の株式売り出しを開始
articles.summary: インドの億万長者ムケシュ・アンバニ氏率いるJioが、低迷する株式市場にもかかわらず、32億ドルの資金調達を目指し、同国で月内2度目となる大規模な新規株式公開（IPO）を開始した。

articles.title: Borneo burning: Life on the frontline of South East Asia's toxic haze
articles.description: A "Super El Niño" has fuelled months-long fires in Indonesia, making hundreds of thousands of people sick.
articles.titleJa: 燃えるボルネオ：東南アジアの有害な煙害の最前線での生活
articles.summary: 「スーパーエルニーニョ」の影響でインドネシアでは数ヶ月にわたる大規模な森林火災が発生し、発生する有害な煙害により数十万人もの人々が健康被害に苦しんでいる。

articles.title: Is Donald Trump ready to do business with Myanmar?
articles.description: There are signs the United States is shifting its policy towards Myanmar, formerly a global pariah.
articles.titleJa: ドナルド・トランプはミャンマーとのビジネスの準備ができているのか？
articles.summary: 米国が、かつて国際的に孤立していたミャンマーに対する政策を転換する兆候が見られ、トランプ政権下での関係進展の可能性が示唆されている。

articles.title: King Charles sends Aung San Suu Kyi books, says Myanmar government
articles.description: Nay Pyi Taw has released rare photographs of Suu Kyi receiving the books along with a sealed letter.
articles.titleJa: チャールズ国王、アウンサンスーチー氏に書籍を送る、とミャンマー政府が発表
articles.summary: ミャンマー政府は、チャールズ国王がアウンサンスーチー氏に書籍と封書を送ったと発表し、スーチー氏がそれらを受け取る珍しい写真を公開した。

articles.title: In pictures: Dussehra celebrated across India as triumph of good over evil
articles.description: The festival, which commemorates the triumph of good over evil, is celebrated with different rituals across India.
articles.titleJa: 写真で見る：インド全土で善の悪に対する勝利として祝われるダシャラー祭
articles.summary: 善が悪に勝利したことを記念するヒンドゥー教のダシャラー祭が、様々な儀式とともにインド全土で盛大に祝われ、その様子が写真で紹介されている。

articles.title: At least 17 dead in crush at Hindu festival event in India
articles.description: Many more have been injured at an event in the Indian city of Kolkata to mark a Hindu festival.

articles.title: Toxic algorithms wouldn't let them go - now Australia wants an off switch
articles.description: The Australian government hopes to protect social media users from being served content they don't want to see.
articles.titleJa: 「有害なアルゴリズム」から離れられない—オーストラリアは今、「オフスイッチ」を求める
articles.summary: オーストラリア政府は、ソーシャルメディアユーザーが望まないコンテンツを提供されることから保護するため、「有害なアルゴリズム」への対策として「オフスイッチ」の導入を目指している。

articles.title: BBC inside Australian court as man charged with attacking MP stays silent in first hearing
articles.description: BBC's Katy Watson describes what unfolded in Wangaratta as 43-year-old Brendan Nugent appeared before court over the alleged attack of Helen Haines.
articles.titleJa: オーストラリアの裁判所内部：議員を襲撃した容疑者が初公判で沈黙
articles.summary: オーストラリアのワンガラッタの裁判所で、議員ヘレン・ヘインズへの襲撃容疑で起訴された43歳のブレンダン・ヌージェント氏が初公判に臨んだが、終始沈黙を保った。

articles.title: Photos show luxury boat with 50m pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat
articles.description: Satellite images give clues about how Kim spends his holidays - something far out of reach for most North Koreans.
articles.titleJa: 金正恩の夏の別荘近くに50mプールとウォータースライド付きの豪華ヨットの写真が公開
articles.summary: 衛星画像により、金正恩氏が夏の休暇を過ごす豪華なヨットが捉えられた。これはほとんどの北朝鮮国民には手の届かない贅沢な生活を示している。

articles.title: WTO and multilateral partners review progress on supply chain finance initiative
articles.description: Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala joined leaders of multilateral development banks and other international organizations at a high-level roundtable held on the sidelines of the 2026 World Bank – International Monetary Fund (IMF) Annual Meetings in Bangkok, Thailand, on 16 October to review progress in expanding supply chain finance in developing economies and to discuss priorities for the next phase of cooperation.
articles.titleJa: WTOと多国間パートナー、サプライチェーン金融イニシアティブの進捗をレビュー
articles.summary: WTOと多国間パートナーが、開発途上国におけるサプライチェーン金融拡大の進捗状況をレビューし、今後の協力の優先事項を議論した。

articles.title: Import Licensing Committee addresses notifications, trade concerns, transparency efforts
articles.description: At its 15 October meeting, the WTO Committee on Import Licensing examined challenges for WTO members in preparing notifications, including findings from a recent WTO workshop for government officials. It also reviewed the latest information on members' notification practices. In addition, the Committee considered a range of trade concerns and reflected on lessons from recent experience-sharing sessions aimed at strengthening communication, public-private engagement and access to information on import licensing procedures.
articles.titleJa: 輸入許可委員会、通報、貿易上の懸念、透明性への取り組みを審議
articles.summary: WTO輸入許可委員会が、加盟国の通報作成の課題、貿易上の懸念、情報アクセス強化のための経験共有の教訓について議論した。

articles.title: Talks kick off for Timor-Leste's accession to government procurement pact
articles.description: At a meeting of the Committee on Government Procurement on 14 October, parties to the Government Procurement Agreement (GPA) 2012 welcomed Timor-Leste's submission of key documents required to kick off its negotiations on acceding to the Agreement. The Committee also reviewed regulatory developments, heard updates on the accession process of other members, and for the first time conducted a dialogue with the private sector on the significance of the Agreement in a changing trade environment.
articles.titleJa: 東ティモールの政府調達協定加盟交渉が開始
articles.summary: 政府調達委員会で、東ティモールが政府調達協定加盟交渉に必要な書類を提出。交渉が開始された。

articles.title: Report underlines value of WTO committee in helping resolve market access trade concerns
articles.description: A first-ever report by the WTO Secretariat on the resolution of trade concerns related to market access highlights the effectiveness of the organization's committee work in helping members settle their differences without resorting to dispute settlement. The report was presented at a 12-13 October meeting of the WTO's Committee on Market Access (CMA). The committee also reviewed a record 36 trade concerns raised by members at its meeting, eight of which were raised for the first time.
articles.titleJa: 報告書が市場アクセスに関する貿易上の懸念解決におけるWTO委員会の価値を強調
articles.summary: WTO事務局の初の報告書が、市場アクセス貿易懸念の解決における委員会の有効性を強調。委員会は36の貿易懸念をレビューした。

articles.title: Madagascar launches safeguard investigation on certain confectionary
articles.description: On 12 October 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 9 October 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of sugar confectionary as well as chocolate and cocoa confectionary.
articles.titleJa: マダガスカル、特定の菓子製品に対するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: マダガスカルが、砂糖菓子およびチョコレート菓子の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知した。

articles.title: WTO-ITC visit to Mogadishu supports Somalia's preparations for next phase of WTO accession
articles.description: The WTO and the International Trade Centre (ITC) conducted their first joint technical assistance activity in Mogadishu, Somalia, from 10 to 15 October to support the government's preparations for the second meeting of the Working Party on the accession of Somalia. Supported by the United Kingdom, the technical assistance event also included discussions on regional integration and the forthcoming Trade for Peace Somalia Initiative.
articles.titleJa: WTO-ITC、ソマリアのWTO加盟準備を支援するためモガディシュを訪問
articles.summary: WTOとITCがソマリアを訪問し、ソマリア政府のWTO加盟作業部会の次回会合に向けた準備を技術的に支援した。

articles.title: AI boom and trade resilience to Middle East crisis lift outlook, but gains to be uneven
articles.description: Global trade proved more resilient than expected in the first half of 2026 despite the disruption caused by the Middle East conflict, as supply chains adapted and strong investment in artificial intelligence provided a powerful boost to goods trade. However, the resilience was not uniform, with services trade and some regions more exposed to the effects of the conflict. WTO economists have therefore raised the forecast for merchandise trade growth in 2026 while lowering the outlook for services trade.
articles.titleJa: AIブームと中東危機に対する貿易の回復力が経済見通しを押し上げるも、恩恵は不均一
articles.summary: 中東紛争にもかかわらず、AI投資により上半期のグローバル貿易は予想以上に回復。しかし、恩恵は地域やサービス貿易で不均一だった。

articles.title: Services bodies spotlight Public Forum, remittance costs and development issues
articles.description: At meetings held from 7 to 9 October, the WTO Council for Trade in Services and the Committee on Trade in Financial Services commended the fruitful discussions on services trade at the 2026 Public Forum, continued discussions on transparency of measures regarding recognition of foreign service suppliers' qualifications, and exchanged views on how to reinvigorate the Council's work. Members also addressed how to facilitate digital payment systems and reduce the cost of remittances, help least-developed countries (LDCs) strengthen their participation in services trade, and various trade concerns.
articles.titleJa: サービス機関、公開フォーラム、送金費用、開発課題に焦点を当てる
articles.summary: WTOサービス貿易理事会が、サービス貿易の議論、送金費用削減、後発開発途上国の参加強化など、多岐にわたる貿易課題を審議した。

articles.title: Rules of Origin Committee reviews LDC preferences, shares best practices
articles.description: The WTO Committee on Rules of Origin (CRO) met on 7-8 October to review developments in preferential rules of origin for least-developed countries (LDCs), hear updates from preference-granting members, and exchange experiences on origin administration and trade facilitation. Members also examined notifications on non-preferential rules of origin, discussed digital tools that can improve transparency and compliance with origin requirements, and considered draft annual reports on the Committee's work.
articles.titleJa: 原産地規則委員会、LDC優遇措置をレビューし、ベストプラクティスを共有
articles.summary: WTO原産地規則委員会が、後発開発途上国向け原産地規則の進展をレビューし、原産地管理と貿易円滑化のベストプラクティスを共有した。

articles.title: General Council addresses WTO reform, ministerial follow-ups, ongoing negotiations
articles.description: WTO members meeting at the General Council on 5-6 October addressed issues related to the ongoing discussions on WTO reform, follow-up to outcomes of past ministerial conferences, and the state of ongoing negotiations on various topics. Members also discussed issues related to the Agreement on Electronic Commerce, emerging agricultural trade issues, and optimizing the outcome of future ministerial conferences, among other issues.
articles.titleJa: 総理事会、WTO改革、閣僚会議のフォローアップ、進行中の交渉について協議
articles.summary: WTO総理事会が、WTO改革、過去の閣僚会議の成果のフォローアップ、電子商取引や農業貿易に関する交渉など、主要な課題を議論した。
